en: A vintage black and white postcard featuring three main images: a large historic building labeled 'Grand Hotel' with horse-drawn carriages and people in front; an arched ruin, likely a Roman-style aqueduct or church ruin; and a panoramic city view across water with the heading 'HILSEN FRA HAMAR - NORGE'. The card includes handwritten text in a Scandinavian language.
